spec.name: read_file
spec.description: Read a file from the sandbox and return its contents.

spec.name: write_file
spec.description: Write content to a file in the sandbox (create or replace).

spec.name: append_file
spec.description: Append content to a file in the sandbox (creating it if absent).

spec.name: edit_file
spec.description: Replace EXACTLY ONE occurrence of `old` with `new` in a sandbox file. Fails with 461 if `old` is not found and 462 if it matches more than once (add surrounding context to make it unique); the file is unchanged on failure.

old.description: the exact text to replace — must match exactly once

new.description: the replacement text (may be empty to delete)

spec.name: list_dir
spec.description: List the entries of a directory in the sandbox (sorted, newline-joined).

path.description: directory path relative to the sandbox

spec.name: list_tree
spec.description: Recursively list a directory in the sandbox: one path per line relative to it, directories marked with a trailing slash, depth-first and sorted. Use path "." for the whole sandbox.

path.description: directory path relative to the sandbox

spec.name: grep_file
spec.description: Return the lines of a sandbox file that contain the given substring.

pattern.description: substring to match on each line

spec.name: grep_tree
spec.description: Search every file under a sandbox directory for a substring; matches print as path:line: text. Use path "." to search the whole sandbox.

path.description: directory path relative to the sandbox

pattern.description: substring to match on each line

spec.name: npm_info
spec.description: Look up an npm package: name@version, description, license, and its dependency names. Returns a short digest, not the raw registry document.

package.description: the package name, e.g. left-pad or @types/node

spec.name: gh_issues
spec.description: List a GitHub repository's open issues (most recently updated first), with the total count and each issue's comment count. Needs a configured token; without one it is denied.

spec.name: fetch
spec.description: HTTP GET a URL and return the response body. Only hosts on the deployment allowlist are reachable.
